sources.authors: Nikolaos Athanasopoulos, Konstantinos Smpoukis, Raphael M. Jungers
sources.title: Invariance in Constrained Switching Systems
sources.locations: Section 2 assumptions and reachability; Theorem 1(ii); Proposition 3(iv); Theorem 2
sources.evidence: Graph-constrained linear systems with edge disturbance sets; explicit logarithmic iteration bound for geometric-tail accuracy; minimal convex invariant multi-set counterpart.
sources.reduction: A workload automaton with affine edge maps is exactly this reachability skeleton; support transforms unions into maxima and affine images into transformed directions.
sources.caveat: Their C-set and strong-connectivity hypotheses must not be silently transferred to singleton disturbances, a prescribed startup node, or a non-strongly-connected lifetime counter.

sources.authors: Krishnendu Chatterjee, Laurent Doyen, Thomas A. Henzinger
sources.title: Quantitative Languages
sources.date: repository record: TOCL 2010; downloaded file is submitted manuscript
sources.locations: Definitions; Theorem 3 (discounted quantitative emptiness); Theorems 5-6; finite-prefix continuity discussion
sources.evidence: Finite-state discounted weighted automata, optimization and decision problems have a mature theory.
sources.reduction: A finite workload/direction-product graph with stationary rewards is a discounted weighted graph.
sources.caveat: Irrational rotation does not give a finite stationary phase graph merely because the workload language is regular. Theorem numbering refers to the opened submitted manuscript.

sources.title: On the Exact Convex Hull of IFS Fractals
sources.evidence: Continuity of attractors in rotation-angle parameters, with rational-angle approximants.
sources.reduction: G6's finite-tolerance angle continuity is a simple specialized contraction/sensitivity estimate.
sources.caveat: Does not establish the exact orientation-envelope circle or a uniform arithmetic complexity classification.

sources.authors: Yushen Huang, Ertai Luo, Stanley Bak, Yifan Sun
sources.title: Reachability Analysis for Linear Systems with Uncertain Parameters using Polynomial Zonotopes
sources.locations: Sections 2-4, especially factor identifiers, Proposition 3, Algorithm 1; Section 5.1 and Algorithm 2; Sections 5.6-5.7
sources.evidence: Explicitly distinct constant-parameter and time-varying-parameter reachability algorithms; preservation of shared factor dependencies.
sources.reduction: Correct fixed-kappa conditional support belongs to established parameter-dependent reachability methodology.
sources.caveat: Publisher route returned 403 and was not retried. Public arXiv author manuscript was separately found and read. No journal full-text inspection claimed; no infinite-horizon G6 complexity theorem attributed.

sources.authors: Shengjie Xu, Bineet Ghosh, Clara Hobbs, P. S. Thiagarajan, Samarjit Chakraborty
sources.title: Safety-Aware Flexible Schedule Synthesis for Cyber-Physical Systems using Weakly-Hard Constraints
sources.evidence: Sliding-window binary success/failure constraints represented as finite automata; product automaton synthesizes schedules preserving safe constraints.
sources.reduction: At most B sign disagreements in every L blocks is the same binary language as at least L-B deadline hits in every L events.
sources.caveat: Its control plant and deadline semantics differ from G6. The exact electrical support reward is our specialization, not a formula asserted in the paper.

sources.authors: Clara Hobbs, Shengjie Xu, Bineet Ghosh, Enrico Fraccaroli, Parasara Sridhar Duggirala, Samarjit Chakraborty
sources.title: Quantitative Safety-Driven Co-Synthesis of Cyber-Physical System Implementations
sources.locations: Section III-A Definitions 1-4; Section III-B-C; Appendix B
sources.evidence: Weakly-hard language constraints, reachability-based worst-deviation bounds, and quantitative implementation co-synthesis.
sources.reduction: Demonstrates that contract-to-dynamical-safety-to-schedule workflow itself already exists.
sources.caveat: This is finite-horizon deviation safety with specified deadline-miss dynamics. It is not G6 infinite-horizon common-sign support or a generic workload-completion theorem.

sources.title: The Convergence Rate of the Sandwich Algorithm for Approximating Convex Functions
sources.date: 1992; author report version title page processed 1995
sources.locations: Introduction pp. 4-5; Theorem 1 and Corollary 1; Corollary 2; Section 5
sources.evidence: Quadratic decay in piece/evaluation count for convex sandwich approximation; polygon approximation and circle/parabola sharpness.
sources.reduction: A robust envelope containing an active circle arc incurs the standard direct-planar epsilon^-1/2 count.
sources.caveat: A worst-class rate does not establish an instance lower bound absent curvature. G6 circle-arc reduction supplies that condition directly.

sources.title: On Polyhedral Approximations of the Second-Order Cone
sources.evidence: Lifted LP approximation of conic-quadratic constraints with O(problem dimension times log(1/epsilon)) variables and inequalities, with explicit multiplicative relaxation.

sources.caveat: Full proof not inspected. Abstract alone explicitly states the needed representation separation. Does not make the entire arbitrary orientation envelope a single SOC.
